title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21

ai_review.summary: Seamons matrix captures an incendiary 1982 NYC show with liquid‑lightning Jerry, standout Playing in the Band, Looks Like Rain and High Time.
ai_review.review: The recording is a top‑notch Seamons Matrix that delivers crystal‑clear balance—every instrument sits nicely and the mix feels perfectly pitched. The performance burns from start to finish, highlighted by a soaring Playing in the Band segue into Crazy Fingers, an unforgettable second lead on Looks Like Rain, and a powerhouse High Time/Estimated jam that leaves the Garden audience on fire.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly 5‑star praise for both the show and the matrix recording, with only one modest 4‑star comment; reviewers consistently cite high energy, superb song renditions, and excellent sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced mix with proper pitch; all band members audible. Reviewers describe it as "great matrix recording," "pitch level seems right," and "everyone can be heard clearly."

show_quality.setlist_flow: The first set launches with a surprise Playing in the Band, builds through Crazy Fingers and a unique second lead on Looks Like Rain, climaxing with an epic China Rider. The second set maintains momentum with Throwing Stones/NFA and a blistering High Time/Estimated sequence.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as "liquid lightning" on his fingers; delivers a rare second lead on Looks Like Rain.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned doing his thing during the Estimated outro, adding to the jam intensity.
